verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so building its runtime from source with few dependencies is a fair question to ask. The pack shows only a Homebrew binary install (brew install, cactus run) and platform/Python requirements for running locally. Nothing documents a source build, its toolchain, or a minimal dependency footprint. The one community note about vendoring llama.cpp is a branding critique, not evidence of a lean source build.
